evidence.reason: The current `process_item` keeps only one `base` and resets it to `job['repair_base']` whenever the run id changes (lines 687-689). With the stated severity-first `finding_order`, a run can reappear after another run (R1 major, R2 major, R1 minor), so the later R1 job starts from the run's original pin instead of the tip of R1's successful chain. That contradicts the function's own comment that successful commits chain by base and would make the later job record the wrong `repair_base` for harvest predecessor checks.
